verdict.rationale: Poke's own docs show it can generate some artifacts: tables and charts from a description or a shared spreadsheet image, and websites it deploys at yourname.poke.com. Nothing documents creating documents or presentations, iterating on edits, or exporting files. missing for 10: document creation, presentation creation, iterative editing of files, file export/download formats, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can have the assistant create and iteratively edit documents, presentations, and other files I can export

citations.quote: Poke can now create tables and charts to help you visualize data.
Poke can also create and deploy websites for you at yourname.poke.com.
